note_title: 命题1：一维的广义的Riemann-Lebesgue引理
summary_en: This note states and proves a one-dimensional generalized Riemann-Lebesgue lemma for bounded measurable periodic functions against \(L^1([a,b])\) functions. The proof emphasizes a general \(L^1\)-approximation strategy, reducing the limit computation to smooth approximants and then using periodic decomposition and Riemann sums.

problems.statement_en:
Let \(f \in L^{1}([a,b])\), and let \(g\) be a measurable bounded periodic function with period \(T\). Then
\[
\lim_{n\to +\infty}\int_{[a,b]} f(x)g(nx)\,dx = \left(\frac{1}{T}\int_{[0,T)} g(x)\,dx\right)\left(\int_{[a,b]} f(x)\,dx\right).
\]
problems.statement_zh:
设 \(f \in L^{1}([a,b])\)，并且 \(g\) 是周期为 \(T\) 的可测有界周期函数，那么
\[
\lim_{n\to +\infty}\int_{[a,b]} f(x)g(nx)\,dx = \left(\frac{1}{T}\int_{[0,T)}g(x)\,dx\right)\left(\int_{[a,b]}f(x)\,dx\right).
\]

key_techniques_discussed: Approximate an \(L^1\) function by simpler functions and transfer the limit via an ε-estimate
Partitioning the stretched interval into full periods plus a remainder
Estimating the leftover interval contribution as \(o(1)\)
Using Riemann sums to recover \(\int_{[a,b]} f_\varepsilon(x)\,dx\)
connections_mentioned: error between Riemann sums and the Riemann integral
equality of Riemann and Lebesgue integrals on closed intervals
